lines.x: Saipem shares surged following the release of strong third-quarter financial results and reaffirmed financial guidance through 2027.
Finnish satellite developer Iceye launched a takeover bid for Italian aerospace and space propulsion group Avio at 41 euros per share.
Shares in Italian tiremaker Pirelli fell 3% to €6.55 on the Milan exchange following reports that major Chinese shareholder Sinochem initiated a secondary share placement.
Milan's benchmark stock index fell 2.25%, dragged lower by drops in STMicroelectronics and Technoprobe amid global AI technology valuation concerns.
